'Instant - {r}: destroy this: The next aura you play this turn costs {r}{r} less to play.'

The {r} is the card-level activation_cost (DSL-authoritative, read by play.py's shared affordability gate for DSL activated abilities) - deliberately NOT also authored as a PAY_RESOURCES ability cost, which would double-charge per IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE. 'destroy this' is the ability-level cost [{DESTROY_SELF}] (cost_types.py ~43); INSTANT activations on equipment are offered by play._add_dsl_activations at any priority window, and paying costs precedes run_ability.

The discount: MODIFY_NEXT_CARD_COST queues a one-shot entry on the controller's dsl_queued_card_mods with amount/filter raw; _cost_mod_matches (play.py ~625) compiles the filter against the card being played, and CARD_IS_TYPE unions types and subtypes so 'Aura' matches however the card data types it. The queue is cleared at end of turn (engine.py ~933), so an unconsumed reduction expires - 'this turn' holds without extra fields; the handler reads no span/scope param and needs none.

Printed Arcane Barrier 1 fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT re-authored here.
